transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?
I’m here because I’m having trouble keeping things organized at work. Tickets, receipts, notes, customer jobs… they all end up piled together, and then I don’t know what to deal with first.
Do you find it hard to stay organized or focused in other areas of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Mostly it’s at work. I mean… that’s where I really notice it. The tickets, receipts, notes from the workshop, customer jobs—everything ends up in one pile, and then I just kind of freeze because I don’t know what to handle first.
Outside of work, do you find it difficult to stay organized or keep track of tasks, like managing household chores, personal items, or following through on plans?

I guess outside of work I don’t notice it as much. It’s really the work stuff… the tickets and receipts and notes, customer jobs, they all get mixed together, and then I can’t tell what I’m supposed to handle first.
Do you ever find yourself struggling to keep track of things or feeling overwhelmed even when you're not at work, like when you're at home or running errands?

Not really that I can say. It’s mostly the work stuff… the tickets and receipts and notes from the workshop, customer jobs. They all end up together, and then I don’t know what I’m supposed to do first.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried about things getting out of control, even when you're not dealing with the tickets or receipts at work?
I don’t really know… I don’t think about it that way. I mostly notice it when the work stuff piles up. Outside of that, I’m not sure.
When you're not at work, do you ever feel anxious or worried about things in general, even when there's no pile of tickets or receipts to deal with?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I feel worried in general. I haven’t really noticed that, unless there’s something specific going on.
When you're completely away from work, like on your days off, do you ever feel anxious or worried about things even when there's nothing specific to deal with?
Not really… I mean, on days off I don’t usually sit around worrying if there’s nothing going on. I might have things to do, but I wouldn’t call it anxious, I guess.
When you're at home or in other places outside of work, do you have trouble organizing tasks or keeping track of what you need to do, even when there are things you know you should be handling?

Yeah… I guess some. It’s more obvious at work, though. The tickets and receipts and notes all end up mixed together, and then I don’t know what to do first. At home I don’t think it’s as bad, or maybe I just don’t notice it the same way.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried even when there’s no specific problem or task to deal with?
I don’t think so. Not if there’s really nothing going on. I mean… I haven’t noticed that kind of worry.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried when there’s absolutely nothing on your plate—no tasks, no work, no specific problems to solve?
No… I don’t think so. If there’s really nothing I have to deal with, I’m usually not sitting there worrying.
Even if there’s nothing specific happening, do you ever feel a general sense of worry or anxiety just sitting with your own thoughts?
Not really… I mean, if nothing’s going on, I don’t usually feel worried just sitting there. At least not that I’ve noticed.
Do you ever find yourself putting off starting tasks, even when you know you need to get them done, whether at work or elsewhere?
I’m not sure… I mean, sometimes I might take a bit to get started, but I haven’t really thought about it much.
Do you find yourself avoiding starting tasks, even when you know they need to be done, whether at work or in other parts of your life?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really paid close attention to it. I just kind of do things when I get to them, I guess.
Do you ever feel anxious or worried even when there’s nothing specific on your mind or no tasks to handle at all?
No… I don’t think so. If there’s nothing going on, I’m usually not sitting there worrying. At least, I haven’t really noticed that.
Do you often have trouble getting started on tasks, even when you know they need to be done, whether at work or in other parts of your life?
I guess… I’m not really sure. I mean, I can drag my feet sometimes, but I don’t know if it’s more than anyone else.
Do you often find it really hard to get started on tasks, even simple ones, to the point where you avoid them or they pile up, even when you know they need to be done?
I’m not sure I’d say it gets that bad. Some things sit for a while, yeah, but I don’t really think of it as avoiding them… I just don’t get around to it right away.
Even when you're not at work and there's absolutely nothing on your plate, do you ever feel a persistent sense of anxiety or worry that seems to come out of nowhere?
Not really… I mean, if nothing’s going on, I don’t usually feel worried for no reason. At least not that I’ve noticed.
Do you often find it difficult to start tasks, even simple ones, because they feel overwhelming or you don’t know where to begin?

Yeah… I guess that’s part of it. At work, things get piled together—tickets, receipts, notes, customer jobs—and then I just sort of freeze because I don’t know what to handle first. That’s mostly what brought me in.
Do you often find it difficult to start tasks, even simple ones, because they feel overwhelming or you don’t know where to begin, and does this happen often enough that it affects your daily life?

Yes… it does. Mostly at work. I can’t seem to keep things in order anymore—tickets, receipts, notes from the workshop, customer jobs… they all pile up, and then I just don’t know what to handle first. That’s really what made me come in.
